versions.content: Allow vendor-specific modification of Standardized Module Definition Type: valid Description: The BSWMD template SHALL allow modification to the Standardized Module Definition in order to support implementation specific adaptations. Rationale: The Standardized Module Definition does specify the superset of possible values per configuration parameter. A certain implementation may restrict the actual applicable characteristics of individual elements in the Standardized Module Definition. Dependencies: [RS_BSWMD_00035] Use Case: The BlockId of the NvRam manager may either be 8 or 16 bit. The standardized parameter has a min value of 1 and a max value of 65535. An implementation may choose to support only the 8 bit values, so the max value has to be adapted to be 255. Supporting Material: 
